'''Hyderabad Kingsmen''' is a professional [[Twenty20]] franchise [[cricket]] team that competed in [[2026 Pakistan Super League]]. Team is based in the [[Hyderabad, Pakistan|Hyderabad]] city of [[Pakistan]]. This was the debut season of the [[Hyderabad Kingsmen|Kingsmen]] alongside [[Rawalpindiz]].<ref name="E1">{{cite news |last1=Baig |first1=Zulfiqar |title=PSL expands as Sialkot, Hyderabad sold for record prices |url=https://tribune.com.pk/story/2585422/psl-expands-as-sialkot-hyderabad-sold-for-record-prices |work=The Express Tribune |date=7 January 2026 |language=en}}</ref>

Kingsmen came into existence after [[Pakistan Cricket Board]] successfully conducted an auction for 2 new teams to expand the league from 6 to 8 teams.<ref name="E1" /> They were coached by [[Jason Gillespie]] in 2026 season<ref>{{cite web |title=Jason Gillespie named as Hyderabad coach |url=https://www.espncricinfo.com/story/psl-2026-jason-gillespie-named-head-coach-of-hyderabad-franchise-1521361 |access-date=10 February 2026}}</ref> and  [[Marnus Labuschagne]] was the [[Captain (cricket)|captain]] of the team.

==Squad==
[[File:20251224 Marnus Labuschagne 02.jpg|200px|thumb|right|alt=Marnus Labuschagne|[[Marnus Labuschagne]] captain of Hyderabad Kingsmen in 2026.]] 
[[Pakistan Super League]] introduced [[Player auction|auction model]] for the first time in [[2026 Pakistan Super League|2026]] season, allowing teams to select players by bidding in [[Pakistani rupees]].<ref name="D1">{{cite news |title=Player auction model to replace draft system for PSL XI |url=https://www.dawn.com/news/1967839 |work=Dawn |date=19 January 2026 |language=en}}</ref> Teams were also allowed to directly sign one foreign player who was not part of [[2025 Pakistan Super League|previous season]].<ref name="D1" /> Hyderabad chose [[Marnus Labuschagne]] as their directly signed player. Teams were also allowed to retain upto 4 players who were part of their squads in previous season while new teams were allowed to sign 4 players before auction to match with other franchises.<ref>{{cite web |title=PSL auction to take place on 11 February |url=https://www.espncricinfo.com/story/pakistan-news-psl-2026-auction-to-take-place-february-11-1520921 |access-date=10 February 2026}}</ref> Hyderabad selected [[Saim Ayub]], [[Usman Khan (cricketer)|Usman Khan]], [[Maaz Sadaqat]] and [[Akif Javed]] as their retentions.

[[2026 Pakistan Super League personnel signings and auction|Player auction]] for the PSL 11 was held on 11 February 2026.<ref name="D1" /> Following is the full squad of [[Hyderabad Kingsmen]] after player auction and Retentions.

== Coaching and Management Staff ==
The franchise appointed former Pakistan Test coach and former Australian pacer [[Jason Gillespie]] as their head coach.<ref name="GillespieCoach">{{cite news |title=Jason Gillespie named head coach of Hyderabad Houston Kingsmen |url=https://a-sports.tv/hyderabad-franchise-reveals-name-ahead-of-psl-11 |work=A Sports |date=7 February 2026}}</ref>

* Head Coach: [[Jason Gillespie]]
* Fielding Coach: [[Grant Bradburn]]
* Batting Coach: Hanif Malik
* Assistant Coach: [[Craig White]]
